verdict.rationale: Databricks documents Genie Code as a built-in assistant in the workspace. It generates and runs code, builds pipelines and AI/BI dashboards, debugs errors, and works with Unity Catalog tables and lineage. It can also run as an autonomous agent that plans, executes, fixes errors and asks for approval before using tools, with multiple parallel chats. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated agentic tasks work as documented.
